source:
This is a major update to Soundscape.

Travel mode is much improved. When you travel by car or bus, Soundscape now calls out road numbers, your direction of travel, and nearby settlements. It also calls out when you cross rivers, canals, firths, and bays. Please update your offline maps to get these new features. Bus stop descriptions are now much better for users in the UK.

Sleep mode can now wake automatically when it detects that you are moving again. You no longer need to remember to wake it yourself.

We reorganized the underlying code so that we can build an iOS app from the same code. This means that in the future, we can release an iOS app with all of the features we have built for Android.

Please continue to report any problems, however small, through Contact Support in the main menu.

reason: All paragraph breaks (and the leading/trailing newline) of the English were dropped, so the dialog renders as one block and the paragraph-based sentence split loses its structure.
C10/TR open question 2: «%1$s'{DAn} %2$s'{A}» says 'from the path to Moor Road'; %1$s is the kind of way, so it should be 'a path leading to Moor Road' (relative clause, the model C10 names).
Same C10 from-to reading as confect_name_to ('from the path to Moor Road via steps'); rephrase as a relative clause.

«Patika'dan çıkmaz sokak'a» = 'from the path to the dead-end street': the from-to reading of C10, and it puts an apostrophe+marker on a common noun. C21 lets the way itself be described as leading to a dead end; %1$s may also be a road name, which the relative clause handles.
Same as confect_name_to_dead_end: from-to reading and a marker on a common noun.
%1$s is the tunnel's full name («Clyde Tunnel», «Avrasya Tüneli»), so adding «tüneline» doubles it («Avrasya Tüneli tüneline giriliyor»). Put the dative on the name instead.

The code prefixes this to a road name («<ahead> Moor Road», IntersectionUtils.kt:591). «düz Moor Road» reads as 'straight Moor Road'; «ileride» gives 'ahead: Moor Road'. (The code concatenates rather than using a template, which is a word-order risk for every language.)
«saat 3'te» is how Turkish says the time 'at 3 o'clock'; the clock-face direction is conventionally «saat 3 yönünde», which also avoids depending on the suffix marker.
«3 seçeneğinden 2. seçenektir» is ungrammatical (possessive on the total); «3 seçenekten 2. seçenek» is the natural 'choice 2 of 3'.

Used as a TalkBack/VoiceOver double-tap hint (talkbackHint in SettingsComponents.kt), so TR-B1 requires the «-mek» form; «Sakla» also means 'store/hide' rather than 'keep this value'. The English comment doesn't say it's a hint (C7).
Used as a double-tap hint (talkbackHint), so TR-B1 requires the «-mek» form: iOS reads «Kullan için çift dokunun».
«5'in 3. ara noktasında Home rotası» ('Home route at the 3rd waypoint of 5') treats the total as the owner of the waypoint and reads awkwardly when spoken.

source: Callout detail controls how much Soundscape tells you about as you walk. Detailed mode calls out everything nearby. Simplified mode leaves out minor paths and service roads, and repeats itself less often. Essential mode calls out streets, junctions and landmarks only. Silent mode makes no automatic callouts at all, leaving beacons, routes and the buttons on the home screen.

source: **When you need silence :**\n\n When you are about to cross a road or just need the app to be quiet, you can turn callouts off. When callouts are off, the app will only tell you information if you manually tap one of the *My Location*, *Nearby Markers*, *Around Me*, or *Ahead of Me* buttons.

source: You can create markers in three ways: searching for the place you would like to save using the search bar, finding somewhere using the *Places Nearby* button, or using the *Current Location* button, all of which can be found on the home screen. Once you have found the place you would like, selecting it will take you to the *Location Details* screen. On this screen, select the *Save as Marker* button.
current: Kayıtlı nokta üç şekilde oluşturabilirsiniz: ana ekrandaki arama çubuğunu kullanarak kaydetmek istediğiniz yeri arayarak, *Yakındaki Yerler* düğmesini kullanarak bir yer bularak veya *Mevcut Konum* düğmesini kullanarak; bunların hepsi ana ekranda bulunur. İstediğiniz yeri bulduktan sonra seçmeniz sizi *Konum Ayrıntıları* ekranına götürecektir. Bu ekranda *Kayıtlı Nokta Olarak Kaydet* düğmesini seçin.

İstediğiniz yeri bulduktan sonra seçmeniz sizi *Konum Ayrıntıları* ekranına götürecektir. Bu ekranda *Kayıtlı Nokta Olarak Kaydet* düğmesini seçin.
reason: «Kayıtlı nokta üç şekilde oluşturabilirsiniz» lacks the object case, and «ana ekrandaki arama çubuğu» repeats the «bunların hepsi ana ekranda bulunur» that follows.

«%4$s'{DAn} beri %3$s» uses the time word «beri» for a distance ('3 km since Glasgow station'); street_description_since uses «bu yana». A clearer phrasing may be «%4$s'{DAn} bu yana %3$s yol alındı»; needs a native speaker.
